proof_body:
by
  intro F f U hU hp hd hl h0
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  obtain ⟨⟨a, haU, ha⟩, ⟨c, hcU, hc⟩⟩ := hcon
  have hfd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U := hl.differentiableOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hd) hU
  have hfa : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ f U := hfd.analyticOnNhd hU
  rcases (hfa c hcU).eventually_eq_zero_or_eventually_ne_zero with hz | hne
  · have := hfa.eqOn_zero_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq_zero hp hcU hz
    exact ha (this haU)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ z in nhds c, z ∈ U ∧ (z ≠ c → f z ≠ 0) :=
    Filter.Eventually.and (hU.mem_nhds hcU) (eventually_nhdsWithin_iff.mp hne)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev
  set r := ε / 2 with hr
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by positivity
  have hcb : Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ Metric.ball c ε := Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by rw [hr]; linarith)
  have hcU' : Metric.closedBall c r ⊆ U := fun z hz => (hball z (hcb hz)).1
  have hsne : (Metric.sphere c r).Nonempty := NormedSpace.sphere_nonempty.mpr hr0.le
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmin⟩ := (isCompact_sphere c r).exists_isMinOn hsne ((hfd.continuousOn.mono (fun z hz => hcU' (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz))).norm)
  have hxne : x ≠ c := by
    intro h
    rw [h, mem_sphere_iff_norm, sub_self, norm_zero] at hx
    exact hr0.ne hx
  have hm : 0 < ‖f x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr ((hball x (hcb (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hx))).2 hxne)
  have hu := (tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_iff_forall_isCompact hU).mp hl _ hcU' (isCompact_closedBall c r)
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff] at hu
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (hu (‖f x‖ / 2) (by positivity)).exists
  have hsph : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c r, ‖f x‖ / 2 ≤ ‖F n z‖ := by
    intro z hz
    have h1 := hn z (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hz)
    have h2 : ‖f x‖ ≤ ‖f z‖ := hmin hz
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at h1
    have h3 := norm_sub_norm_le (f z) (F n z)
    linarith
  have hcen : ‖F n c‖ < ‖f x‖ / 2 := by
    have h1 := hn c (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hr0.le)
    rw [dist_eq_norm, hc, zero_sub, norm_neg] at h1
    exact h1
  have hinv : DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z => (F n z)⁻¹) (Metric.ball c r) := by
    apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
    rw [closure_ball c hr0.ne']
    exact ((hd n).mono hcU').inv (fun z hz => h0 n z (hcU' hz))
  have hbd := Complex.norm_le_of_forall_mem_frontier_norm_le (U := Metric.ball c r) (z := c) Metric.isBounded_ball hinv (C := (‖f x‖ / 2)⁻¹) (by
    intro z hz
    rw [frontier_ball c hr0.ne'] at hz
    simp only [norm_inv]
    exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (hsph z hz)) (subset_closure (Metric.mem_ball_self hr0))
  rw [norm_inv] at hbd
  have hp2 : 0 < ‖F n c‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (h0 n c hcU)
  have := (inv_le_inv₀ hp2 (by positivity)).mp hbd
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ), IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) U) → TendstoLocallyUniformlyOn F f Filter.atTop U → (∀ n, ∀ z ∈ U, F n z ≠ 0) → (∀ z ∈ U, f z = 0) ∨ (∀ z ∈ U, f z ≠ 0)
